summary: Master Financial Planning and Analysis training with Excel models, forecasts, variance analysis, and dashboards. Enroll to strengthen decision support.
lede: Financial planning and analysis connects budgets, forecasts, and performance data to decisions about business operations. For finance professionals responsible for planning, budgeting, analysis, or reporting, this course develops practical skills for producing forecasts and explaining performance. It covers rolling forecasts, driver-based Excel models, scenario analysis, variance commentary, and KPI dashboards, linking assumptions and operational drivers to financial outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who already work with planning, analysis, budgeting, or reporting and need sharper FP&A capability. It is especially relevant if you are responsible for forecasts, budget packs, variance commentary, dashboards, or leadership reporting. FP&A Analysts who build forecasts and management packs. Finance Business Partners who support operating decisions. Budget Managers who coordinate planning across departments. Management Accountants who analyze performance and variances. Finance Managers who oversee planning and reporting cycles. Commercial Finance Analysts who translate revenue drivers into models. Controllers who strengthen forecasting and reporting controls. Cost Centre Managers who own budget inputs. Business Unit Finance Leads who align plans with strategy. Operations Analysts who connect operational drivers to financial outcomes.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and the ability to open Power BI examples if provided. A calculator, note-taking tools, and access to a sample budgeting or reporting file will help you complete the practical exercises. Prior experience in finance, budgeting, or management reporting is recommended.
